pci_dss.name: PCI DSS 4.0.1 Requirement 7.2.4
pci_dss.eyebrow: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0.1
pci_dss.title: PCI DSS Access Review Report
pci_dss.subtitle: Requirement 7.2.4 review of access to PCI-scoped data in {organization}'s {provider_scope}
pci_dss.control: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 7.2.4, user access review
pci_dss.other_systems: Other systems in {organization}'s cardholder data environment are reviewed separately.
pci_dss.confidentiality: This report contains confidential information about {organization}'s systems and personnel. Distribute only to people involved in {organization}'s PCI DSS assessment.
pci_dss.purpose: It was prepared to support {organization}'s PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance for the assessment period ending {period_to}.
pci_dss.requirement: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 7.2.4: all user accounts and related access privileges, including third-party and vendor accounts, are reviewed at least once every six months. The review confirms that access remains appropriate for each person's job function, that inappropriate access is addressed, and that management acknowledges the remaining access is appropriate.

checklist.requirement: Reviewed at least every six months

soc2.name: SOC 2 CC6.2 and CC6.3
soc2.wording_source: drafted from the report template's framework list; not reviewed by an auditor or lawyer
soc2.title: SOC 2 Access Review Report
soc2.subtitle: CC6.2 and CC6.3 review of access to in-scope data in {organization}'s {provider_scope}
soc2.control: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria CC6.2 and CC6.3, user access review
soc2.other_systems: Other systems in scope for {organization}'s SOC 2 examination are reviewed separately.
soc2.confidentiality: This report contains confidential information about {organization}'s systems and personnel. Distribute only to people involved in {organization}'s SOC 2 examination.
soc2.purpose: It was prepared as evidence for {organization}'s SOC 2 examination covering the period ending {period_to}.
soc2.requirement: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria CC6.2 and CC6.3: access is authorized before it is granted, and is reviewed, changed and removed so that unnecessary and inappropriate individuals do not keep it. The company sets the review interval, and this report states it.

checklist.requirement: Reviewed at the interval the company set
Access authorized by a named person

hipaa.name: HIPAA 164.308(a)(4)
hipaa.wording_source: drafted from the report template's framework list; not reviewed by an auditor or lawyer
hipaa.title: HIPAA Access Review Report
hipaa.subtitle: Information access management review of access to patient data in {organization}'s {provider_scope}
hipaa.control: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.308(a)(4), information access management
hipaa.other_systems: Other systems that hold {organization}'s electronic protected health information are reviewed separately.
hipaa.confidentiality: This report contains confidential information about {organization}'s systems and personnel. Distribute only to people involved in {organization}'s HIPAA compliance review.
hipaa.purpose: It was prepared as evidence for {organization}'s HIPAA Security Rule compliance for the period ending {period_to}.
hipaa.requirement: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.308(a)(4), information access management: policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information, and for establishing, documenting, reviewing and modifying each person's access. The rule sets no review interval. Section 3 names the sites that hold patient data.

checklist.requirement: Sites that hold patient data named
Access authorized by a named person
